question: Under what condition should the practice be revealed according to the nine Durgā procedure?
premises: The nine Durgā procedure provides the method.
Revelation or demonstration is conditionally permitted.
The condition is the importance of the task.
inference: Because of the importance of the task, one may reveal it according to the procedure of the nine Durgās.
uncertainties: The object of darśayet is implicit from context.
plain_english: Because of the importance of the task, one should reveal it according to the procedure of the nine Durgās.
